text:
mike: Quick sync — proposing a telemetry + dashboard contract for SM occupancy, SM memory, and queue depth across Hosted + Dedicated pools. Need routing/quotas consumers to chime in. ping @sarah @anita @devon @kevin :eyes:
sarah: love the idea. two big concerns off the bat: cardinality and ingest cost. we need standardized tags and sensible sampling windows so we don't blow the metrics bill.
anita: Agreed. draft tags: pool_type=(hosted|dedicated), pool_id, region, model_name (optional, high-cardinality), instance_type, slot_size, tenant_id (for dedicated). metric names i'd propose: `redwood.infra.gpu.sm.occupancy_pct`, `redwood.infra.gpu.sm.memory_used_mb`, `redwood.infra.gpu.queue.depth`. keep prefix consistent for dashboards + alerting.
devon: Queue depth is tricky — we need per-pool and per-worker in some cases. including model_name everywhere will spike cardinality. suggestion: emit model_name only for top-N models or as sampled attribute. emission rates: occupancy/memory every 10s, queue.depth event-driven + 1s when queue>threshold.
kevin: Ingest path: prefer OTLP metrics -> metrics-collector -> prometheus-style storage. avoids pushgateway hacks. we'll want a short proto example for infra to implement. also need a stable label set for routing consumers.
mike: proto snippet for implementers:
```
message GpuMetric {
  string name = 1; // redwood.infra.gpu.sm.occupancy_pct
  double value = 2;
  map<string,string> labels = 3; // pool_type, pool_id, region, instance_type, slot_size, tenant_id?
  int64 ts_unix = 4;
}
```
keep numeric types simple.
lucy: Add `usable_slots` and `reserved_slots` as optional metrics for Dedicated — quota team needs those to reconcile tenant allocation vs available capacity. also add label `exposure_level` = (full|sampled|none) so consumer knows if model_name was redacted.
dave: Dashboard/UX thoughts: main console view = heatmap of `occupancy_pct` by pool (rows=pool_id, cols=hour buckets), timeline for `memory_used_mb`, sparkline for `queue.depth`. For routing: compute headroom = max_capacity_slots - active_slots - queued_work (approx). routing policy should prefer pools with headroom>threshold. We'll need a documented query for the console and for the routing API to reference (example below).
kevin: example Prom-ish query for headroom by pool: `headroom(pool_id) = pool_capacity_slots - avg_over_time(active_slots[1m]) - max_over_time(queue_depth[30s])` — tweak windows in practice. note: prometheus rollups and histogram buckets might be useful for latency ties.
platform-qa: I'll own a test matrix: ensure missing labels don't break dashboards, sampling flags respected, cardinality guard rails in metrics-collector, and backfill behavior for new metrics. also plan perf test that simulates 10k streaming occupancy points/sec.
mike: rollout plan: feature-flag `runtime.metric_exposure` with values `off|canary|on`. start canary at 5% of pools for 24h, validate storage cost and dashboard surfaces, then 25% for 48h, then ramp. provide toggle per-region.
sarah: alerts: add alert when queue.depth(pooled) > X for >30s (backpressure), and when occupancy_pct>90% + memory_used_mb nearing capacity. tie to oncall runbooks (cc eng-oncall).
ops-bot: scheduled: telemetry-consumer v2 deploy window: 2026-04-05 02:00 UTC — will include label normalization step. :robot_face:
kevin: open question — should we publish per-tenant dedicated metrics to the hosted telemetry cluster or keep them in customer-managed telemetry and surface aggregated views? security/privacy will drive this. i'd prefer aggregated exposures (no tenant_id) in hosted, full labels in private telemetry.
lucy: quota team needs tenant_id for billing reconciliation. compromise: ship tenant_id only into private telemetry; emit `tenant_hash` (stable, salted) to hosted for correlation without exposing raw tenant IDs.
dave: UX for rollouts: console should show which pools are in canary and a small cost estimate for enabling metrics (per-hour tokens). transparency will help product and customers.
mike: next actions: (1) @kevin create proto PR + sampler config, (2) @devon update runtime emit code with `exposure_level` flag, (3) @platform-qa create test matrix, (4) @lucy coordinate quota requirements for tenant hashing. i'll draft a short doc and link to dashboard mock screenshots. thanks all :thumbsup:
platform-qa: noted, i'll add test ACLs and a small dataset for dashboard mockups.
ops-bot: linked issue created: https://redwood-internal/infra/metrics/5832 — assigned to kevin, devon, platform-qa.
